visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A dragonfly nymph crawling out of the water onto a reed, its back splitting to reveal the damp, crumpled wings of the adult; Top-Right (Dining): The dragonfly snatching a small gnat mid-air with its 'leg-basket'; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Clinging to the underside of a broad fern leaf during a rain shower, wings folded back; Bottom-Right (Playing/Social): Two dragonflies engaged in a spiraling aerial 'dogfight' over a sunlit patch of the river.
visual_logic.style_notes: Emphasize the 'transformation' in the birth quadrant—making it look magical and heroic for a child audience.
